meta.homeTitle: Vladyslav Otroshchenko — Frontend Engineer for fast websites and React apps
meta.homeDescription: Websites, React / Next.js applications and AI integrations that load fast, rank in search and turn visitors into clients. 10+ years of experience with luxury brands, auction houses and e-commerce.
meta.workDescription: Selected projects for independent watchmakers, Ineichen Auctioneers, Artle and e-commerce: fast, polished websites and React applications.
meta.contactDescription: Tell me about your website or web application. You get a concrete answer with next steps within two working days.

hero.lead: Websites and React apps that load in a blink, rank in search and turn visitors into clients. From the first layout to launch, without agency overhead.

experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: 10+ years of building interfaces from scratch, from landing pages to complex applications. Today: React, Next.js and TypeScript with server rendering, reliable typed data and animation that stays smooth at 60 FPS, even on a mid-range phone.

tehmart.text: Interfaces for luxury brands and high-traffic platforms, including Konstantin Chaykin and Ineichen Auctioneers. Bespoke responsive layouts, GSAP and Three.js animation that never stutters, and React / Next.js applications built from zero with Supabase and Zod behind them.

stats.label: target for every animation, on desktop and phone

stmaria.text: Rebuilt the frontend of a live pharmacy e-shop on OpenCart without stopping sales: a mobile-first interface, faster pages, a cleaner path to checkout, technical SEO and feeds and tracking for Google, Seznam, Heureka and Zboží.cz.

stats.label: people on the site at the same time

helpmed.text: Patient and doctor interfaces for a telemedicine service, built on an in-house UI component library: live updates in real time, mobile apps from one codebase, and data turned into clear, maintainable screens.

stats.label: in-house component library, shared by every screen

skills.title: Skills and technologies
skills.intro: A modern, proven stack: your project stays fast, secure and easy for the next developer to pick up.

notes.aiapps: AI built into the product itself: assistants and chat that answer from your own data, smart search, content and product-description generation, and document processing, with streaming responses, cost control and safe handling of user data.
notes.analytics: Conversion tracking, product feeds and a clean data layer, set up at the code level so ads and reports count every order correctly. For the Czech market that includes Seznam: Sklik, Zboží.cz and Heureka.
notes.ai: AI tools speed up the routine: scaffolding, refactoring, tests and review. You get results sooner and pay for fewer hours, while architecture decisions stay mine and every line is read before it ships.

services.title: What I can do for you
services.intro: I take on only a few projects at a time, so yours gets my full attention: you talk directly to the person who writes the code, with no handoffs between managers.

sites.title: Websites and landing pages that sell
sites.text: A fast, search-friendly site from your design, or one we design together. Pages that open in under a second, content you edit yourself, and a structure Google understands from day one.

apps.title: React web applications
apps.text: Dashboards, shops and internal tools that just work. Login, forms, payments and typed data from the database to the button, so new features don’t break old ones.

ai.title: AI integrations
ai.text: An assistant that knows your products and documents, search that understands questions, automatic descriptions, summaries and data extraction. Built into your site or app with streaming answers, sensible costs and your data kept under control.
ai.stack: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Vercel AI SDK, RAG

motion.title: Animation and 3D people remember
motion.text: Scroll stories, product reveals and 3D scenes that keep visitors on the page longer. Smooth on a mid-range phone and respectful of reduced-motion settings.

performance.title: Speed and technical SEO
performance.text: Slow site, slipping in search? An audit with a clear, prioritised list of fixes, then the fixes themselves: Core Web Vitals, images and fonts, structured data, plus analytics and conversion tracking you can trust.
performance.stack: Lighthouse, Search Console, GA4, Tag Manager

cta.title: Let’s make your site work for you
cta.text: Send a few lines about your project. Within two working days you get a concrete answer: approach, timeline and a price range.

work.title: Work
work.intro: Websites and applications from recent years, mostly for the watch world: independent makers, auction houses and the platforms around them. Real projects, live in production.
